title:
As Tyson was riding into Jerusalem
     He fell and hurt his Alec Kafoozelum.
html_source:
The end rhyme here (“Jerusalem” and “Kafoozelum”) essentially set the ridiculing tone to this little “couplet.” Again, the use of form here shows the sneering tone of the speaker, this instance from Boland.

(Pictured: Jerusalem and the “Dome of the Rock”)
